title: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
description: David prepares a place for God's ark in the City of David and gathers all Israel to Jerusalem. He commands that only the Levites are to carry the ark, and the heads of the Levite families consecrate themselves for this task. The Levites carry the ark on their shoulders with poles, just as Moses had commanded, while the singers play harps, lyres, cymbals, and trumpets. David and the people bring the ark from the house of Obed-Edom with joy and offer seven bulls and seven rams. Dressed in linen and an ephod, David dances before the ark, but Michal, Saul's daughter, looks out through a window and despises him in her heart.[ref:1 Chr 15:1-29|1 Chronicles 15:1-29]
